# awscc_route53_query_logging_config (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Route53::QueryLoggingConfig



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the query logging configuration.
- `cloudwatch_logs_log_group_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the CloudWatch Logs log group in us-east-1 that Amazon Route 53 publishes query logs to.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The ID of the public hosted zone that Amazon Route 53 logs queries for.
- `query_logging_config_id` (String) The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigns to the configuration for DNS query logging.
